designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system expresses a refined synthesis of high-end wealth tech and effortless property operations. Built specifically for independent landlords and portfolio managers overseeing high-value residential and commercial assets, the visual tone conveys institutional authority, effortless command, and meticulous order. 

The aesthetic marries **Corporate / Modern clarity** with selective **Glassmorphic precision** and architectural layering. Deep midnight foundations meet airy, luminous foregrounds, evoking the calm confidence of a private banking terminal combined with the tactile delight of best-in-class consumer mobile tools. 

Key Brand Attributes:
- **Sovereign & Grounded:** Imparts complete legal safety and financial transparency through authoritative indigos and structured spatial grids.
- **Luminous Efficiency:** High-friction property tasks (e.g., rent collection, lease drafting, tenant verification) feel light, modern, and rapid through clean card stacks and vivid emerald-to-cyan directional accents.
- **Architectural Craft:** Uncompromising attention to borders, subtle backdrop filters, and dedicated numerical balance for multi-currency asset views.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an **8px base grid unit**, engineered primarily for thumb-first mobile usage before scaling cleanly to tablets and desktop portfolio screens.

### Spatial Architecture
- **Mobile First (0px – 639px):** Single-column fluid presentation. Outer screen margins are locked to `16px` (`margin`) to maximize data density while maintaining edge airiness. Column gutters run at `16px`. Critical financial summary stacks sit at the top, followed by unified list streams.
- **Tablet (640px – 1023px):** Transition to an 8-column layout with `24px` margins and gutters. Dual split-pane flows become available (property list on the left, active lease view on the right).
- **Desktop (1024px+):** 12-column bounded grid, capped at a maximum width of `1280px` to maintain optimal data scanning speeds. Left-rail pinned navigation (`260px` fixed), dynamic dashboard workspace, and a contextual side drawer for transaction details.

### Spacing Principles
- Gaps between logical cards never drop below `space-md` (16px).
- Internal card padding scales between `space-md` (compact mobile records) and `space-lg` (hero dashboard overview panels).
- Fixed floating action bars adhere to a strict bottom safe-margin plus `space-md` to remain clear of native navigation handles.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses layered ambient shadows combined with subtle frosted glass to maintain depth without clutter.

### Elevation Levels

- **Level 0 (Flat):** Base canvas `#F6F7FB`. Direct sub-panels, empty states, and inactive card borders.
- **Level 1 (Card Default):** Standard property cards and table rows.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 2px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.04), 0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.02)`
  - Border: `1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8)`
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating / Active Hover):** Swiped cards, active dropdown menus, and raised list items.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 12px 24px -6px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.08), 0px 4px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.03)`
- **Level 3 (Modal / Persistent Floating Bars):** Floating Action Buttons (FABs), lease verification overlays, bottom sheets.
  - Shadow: `0px 20px 32px -8px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.16), 0px 8px 16px -4px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`

### Glassmorphism Treatment
- **Executive Card Banners:** Linear gradient from `#0B1026` to `#3B2FA0` with an overlay border of `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)`.
- **Top Bar Filter Strip:** Background `rgba(246, 247, 251, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` and a bottom hairline divider in `rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action:** 
  - Background: Gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #06B6D4 100%)`.
  - Color: `#FFFFFF`, weight 600 (`label-lg`).
  - Height: `48px` on mobile for tap target ergonomics.
  - Shadow: `0px 4px 14px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35)`.
  - Radius: `12px`.
- **Secondary (Navy Dark):**
  - Background: `#0B1026`. Color: `#FFFFFF`. Radius: `12px`.
- **Ghost / Outlined:**
  - Border: `1.5px solid #E2E8F0`. Color: `#0B1026`. Background: `#FFFFFF`.

### Chips & Filter Tags
- **Default:** Pill-shaped (`9999px`), `32px` height, `#FFFFFF` background, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, typography `label-md` (`#0B1026`).
- **Active Filter:** Background `#0B1026`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #0B1026`.
- **Status Indicator Badges:** Soft translucent tints (e.g., Paid: `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`, text `#10B981`; Overdue: `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)`, text `#EF4444`). 
- **Pro Tier Badge:** Background `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.15), rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.3))`, text `#B45309`, border `1px solid rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.4)`.

### Cards (Property & Ledger Units)
- **Structure:** Clean white `#FFFFFF` shell, `20px` corner radius, `Level 1` elevation.
- **Header Slot:** Left-aligned unit/building identifier (`headline-md`), right-aligned status badge.
- **Body Slot:** Tabular split-view displaying Tenant Name and Rupee Amount (`financial-md`) with sub-labels (`body-sm`).
- **Interactive Stacks:** Tap transitions to `Level 2` elevation with smooth sub-150ms ease curve.

### Input Fields
- **Container:** Height `52px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, corner radius `12px`.
- **States:** Active/Focus state uses `1.5px solid #3B2FA0` with an outer ring of `rgba(59, 47, 160, 0.1)`.
- **Prefix / Suffix Elements:** Persistent rupee symbol `₹` or tenancy dates locked in muted tone (`#64748B`).

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size: `20px × 20px`, corner radius `6px` for checkboxes, `50%` for radios.
- Unchecked: Border `2px solid #CBD5E1`, background `#FFFFFF`.
- Checked: Background `#10B981`, border `#10B981`, white crisp checkmark/inner dot.

### Specialized System Components
- **Floating Tenant Quick-Action Dock:** A docked mobile pill fixed at screen bottom with a glassmorphic dark container (`rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.9)`, backdrop blur `20px`, rounded-full) containing dynamic shortcuts for "Collect Rent", "Log Expense", and "Draft Lease".
- **Rupee Ledger Row:** Borderless list row featuring an avatar anchor, auto-formatted currency block with sign indicator (+/-), and split status color indicator.

## Brand & Style

This design system expresses a refined synthesis of high-end wealth tech and effortless property operations. Built specifically for independent landlords and portfolio managers overseeing high-value residential and commercial assets, the visual tone conveys institutional authority, effortless command, and meticulous order. 

The aesthetic marries **Corporate / Modern clarity** with selective **Glassmorphic precision** and architectural layering. Deep midnight foundations meet airy, luminous foregrounds, evoking the calm confidence of a private banking terminal combined with the tactile delight of best-in-class consumer mobile tools. 

Key Brand Attributes:
- **Sovereign & Grounded:** Imparts complete legal safety and financial transparency through authoritative indigos and structured spatial grids.
- **Luminous Efficiency:** High-friction property tasks (e.g., rent collection, lease drafting, tenant verification) feel light, modern, and rapid through clean card stacks and vivid emerald-to-cyan directional accents.
- **Architectural Craft:** Uncompromising attention to borders, subtle backdrop filters, and dedicated numerical balance for multi-currency asset views.

## Colors

The palette establishes sharp hierarchy by anchoring foundational data against deep midnight surfaces, balanced by luminous, airy canvases for daily workflow efficiency.

### Palette Architecture
- **Primary Accent (`#10B981`):** Precision emerald green. Used for critical forward action points, confirmation triggers, positive ledger states, and primary CTAs. Paired in functional gradients with deep cyan (`#06B6D4`) to create high-conversion interactive elements.
- **Secondary Foundation (`#3B2FA0`):** Royal indigo. Represents institutional stability, deep navigation rails, primary headers, and selected state backdrops. Transitions outward into electric violet (`#7C3AED`) on hero summary containers and executive dashboard metrics.
- **Tertiary Accent (`#F5B942`):** Warm bullion gold. Reserved strictly for tier status badges, Pro feature tags, high-yield indicators, and verified premium landlord credentials.
- **Neutral Foundation (`#0B1026`):** Deep navy abyss. Powers structural typography, extreme contrast surfaces, dark-mode header caps, and critical data anchors.

### Functional Surfaces & Backgrounds
- **App Canvas:** Soft off-white `#F6F7FB`. Minimizes glare and reduces visual fatigue during prolonged lease reviews.
- **Elevated Surfaces:** Pure white `#FFFFFF` for content cards and interaction layers.
- **Glassmorphic Overlays:** `#0B1026` at 75% opacity with 20px blur for dark floating chrome; `#FFFFFF` at 80% opacity with 16px blur for light-mode sticky navigational bars.
- **Structural Outlines:** `#E2E8F0` for interior dividers; `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)` over dark gradient banners.

### Semantic Feedback
- **Paid / Active:** `#10B981` (Emerald)
- **Due Soon / Impending Action:** `#F59E0B` (Amber)
- **Overdue / Escalate:** `#EF4444` (Crimson)
- **Renewal / Notice Period:** `#3B82F6` (Electric Blue)

## Typography

The typography pairs **Plus Jakarta Sans** for expressive, geometric, and modern display contexts with **Inter** for dense tabular ledgers, status microcopy, and financial numerals.

### Typographic Principles
- **Currency & Metric Formatting:** All monetary entries (e.g., `₹`, `USD`) must employ `Inter` with tabular figures enabled (`font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1`) to guarantee perfect horizontal alignment across rental roll rosters and audit stacks.
- **Editorial Hierarchy:** Strict distinction between section headers (displaying friendly yet assertive curves) and administrative data tags (clinical, legible, and compact).
- **Responsive Downscaling:** Display headers scale down smoothly on narrow viewports to avoid awkward word wraps on mobile devices.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an **8px base grid unit**, engineered primarily for thumb-first mobile usage before scaling cleanly to tablets and desktop portfolio screens.

### Spatial Architecture
- **Mobile First (0px – 639px):** Single-column fluid presentation. Outer screen margins are locked to `16px` (`margin`) to maximize data density while maintaining edge airiness. Column gutters run at `16px`. Critical financial summary stacks sit at the top, followed by unified list streams.
- **Tablet (640px – 1023px):** Transition to an 8-column layout with `24px` margins and gutters. Dual split-pane flows become available (property list on the left, active lease view on the right).
- **Desktop (1024px+):** 12-column bounded grid, capped at a maximum width of `1280px` to maintain optimal data scanning speeds. Left-rail pinned navigation (`260px` fixed), dynamic dashboard workspace, and a contextual side drawer for transaction details.

### Spacing Principles
- Gaps between logical cards never drop below `space-md` (16px).
- Internal card padding scales between `space-md` (compact mobile records) and `space-lg` (hero dashboard overview panels).
- Fixed floating action bars adhere to a strict bottom safe-margin plus `space-md` to remain clear of native navigation handles.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses layered ambient shadows combined with subtle frosted glass to maintain depth without clutter.

### Elevation Levels

- **Level 0 (Flat):** Base canvas `#F6F7FB`. Direct sub-panels, empty states, and inactive card borders.
- **Level 1 (Card Default):** Standard property cards and table rows.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 2px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.04), 0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.02)`
  - Border: `1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8)`
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating / Active Hover):** Swiped cards, active dropdown menus, and raised list items.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 12px 24px -6px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.08), 0px 4px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.03)`
- **Level 3 (Modal / Persistent Floating Bars):** Floating Action Buttons (FABs), lease verification overlays, bottom sheets.
  - Shadow: `0px 20px 32px -8px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.16), 0px 8px 16px -4px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`

### Glassmorphism Treatment
- **Executive Card Banners:** Linear gradient from `#0B1026` to `#3B2FA0` with an overlay border of `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)`.
- **Top Bar Filter Strip:** Background `rgba(246, 247, 251, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` and a bottom hairline divider in `rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`.

## Shapes

The design system incorporates generous curvature that softens high-density financial data while maintaining a clean, contemporary profile.

### Geometry Specifications
- **Base Components (Inputs, Buttons, Badges):** Standardized corner radius of `0.5rem` (8px) to `0.75rem` (12px).
- **Core Cards & Panels:** Smooth, modern rounding of `1.25rem` to `1.5rem` (20px to 24px) for mobile property cards, ledger sheets, and summary containers.
- **Pill Containers:** Badges, quick-filter chips, and floating tab triggers use fully rounded pill geometry (`9999px`).
- **Icons & Badges:** Rounded, Lucide-style line weight matching typography scales (1.75px to 2px stroke weight with rounded terminals).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action:** 
  - Background: Gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #06B6D4 100%)`.
  - Color: `#FFFFFF`, weight 600 (`label-lg`).
  - Height: `48px` on mobile for tap target ergonomics.
  - Shadow: `0px 4px 14px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35)`.
  - Radius: `12px`.
- **Secondary (Navy Dark):**
  - Background: `#0B1026`. Color: `#FFFFFF`. Radius: `12px`.
- **Ghost / Outlined:**
  - Border: `1.5px solid #E2E8F0`. Color: `#0B1026`. Background: `#FFFFFF`.

### Chips & Filter Tags
- **Default:** Pill-shaped (`9999px`), `32px` height, `#FFFFFF` background, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, typography `label-md` (`#0B1026`).
- **Active Filter:** Background `#0B1026`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #0B1026`.
- **Status Indicator Badges:** Soft translucent tints (e.g., Paid: `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`, text `#10B981`; Overdue: `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)`, text `#EF4444`). 
- **Pro Tier Badge:** Background `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.15), rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.3))`, text `#B45309`, border `1px solid rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.4)`.

### Cards (Property & Ledger Units)
- **Structure:** Clean white `#FFFFFF` shell, `20px` corner radius, `Level 1` elevation.
- **Header Slot:** Left-aligned unit/building identifier (`headline-md`), right-aligned status badge.
- **Body Slot:** Tabular split-view displaying Tenant Name and Rupee Amount (`financial-md`) with sub-labels (`body-sm`).
- **Interactive Stacks:** Tap transitions to `Level 2` elevation with smooth sub-150ms ease curve.

### Input Fields
- **Container:** Height `52px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, corner radius `12px`.
- **States:** Active/Focus state uses `1.5px solid #3B2FA0` with an outer ring of `rgba(59, 47, 160, 0.1)`.
- **Prefix / Suffix Elements:** Persistent rupee symbol `₹` or tenancy dates locked in muted tone (`#64748B`).

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size: `20px × 20px`, corner radius `6px` for checkboxes, `50%` for radios.
- Unchecked: Border `2px solid #CBD5E1`, background `#FFFFFF`.
- Checked: Background `#10B981`, border `#10B981`, white crisp checkmark/inner dot.

### Specialized System Components
- **Floating Tenant Quick-Action Dock:** A docked mobile pill fixed at screen bottom with a glassmorphic dark container (`rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.9)`, backdrop blur `20px`, rounded-full) containing dynamic shortcuts for "Collect Rent", "Log Expense", and "Draft Lease".
- **Rupee Ledger Row:** Borderless list row featuring an avatar anchor, auto-formatted currency block with sign indicator (+/-), and split status color indicator.

The palette establishes sharp hierarchy by anchoring foundational data against deep midnight surfaces, balanced by luminous, airy canvases for daily workflow efficiency.

### Palette Architecture
- **Primary Accent (`#10B981`):** Precision emerald green. Used for critical forward action points, confirmation triggers, positive ledger states, and primary CTAs. Paired in functional gradients with deep cyan (`#06B6D4`) to create high-conversion interactive elements.
- **Secondary Foundation (`#3B2FA0`):** Royal indigo. Represents institutional stability, deep navigation rails, primary headers, and selected state backdrops. Transitions outward into electric violet (`#7C3AED`) on hero summary containers and executive dashboard metrics.
- **Tertiary Accent (`#F5B942`):** Warm bullion gold. Reserved strictly for tier status badges, Pro feature tags, high-yield indicators, and verified premium landlord credentials.
- **Neutral Foundation (`#0B1026`):** Deep navy abyss. Powers structural typography, extreme contrast surfaces, dark-mode header caps, and critical data anchors.

- **App Canvas:** Soft off-white `#F6F7FB`. Minimizes glare and reduces visual fatigue during prolonged lease reviews.

- **Glassmorphic Overlays:** `#0B1026` at 75% opacity with 20px blur for dark floating chrome; `#FFFFFF` at 80% opacity with 16px blur for light-mode sticky navigational bars.

## Brand & Style

This design system expresses a refined synthesis of high-end wealth tech and effortless property operations. Built specifically for independent landlords and portfolio managers overseeing high-value residential and commercial assets, the visual tone conveys institutional authority, effortless command, and meticulous order. 

The aesthetic marries **Corporate / Modern clarity** with selective **Glassmorphic precision** and architectural layering. Deep midnight foundations meet airy, luminous foregrounds, evoking the calm confidence of a private banking terminal combined with the tactile delight of best-in-class consumer mobile tools. 

Key Brand Attributes:
- **Sovereign & Grounded:** Imparts complete legal safety and financial transparency through authoritative indigos and structured spatial grids.
- **Luminous Efficiency:** High-friction property tasks (e.g., rent collection, lease drafting, tenant verification) feel light, modern, and rapid through clean card stacks and vivid emerald-to-cyan directional accents.
- **Architectural Craft:** Uncompromising attention to borders, subtle backdrop filters, and dedicated numerical balance for multi-currency asset views.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an **8px base grid unit**, engineered primarily for thumb-first mobile usage before scaling cleanly to tablets and desktop portfolio screens.

### Spatial Architecture
- **Mobile First (0px – 639px):** Single-column fluid presentation. Outer screen margins are locked to `16px` (`margin`) to maximize data density while maintaining edge airiness. Column gutters run at `16px`. Critical financial summary stacks sit at the top, followed by unified list streams.
- **Tablet (640px – 1023px):** Transition to an 8-column layout with `24px` margins and gutters. Dual split-pane flows become available (property list on the left, active lease view on the right).
- **Desktop (1024px+):** 12-column bounded grid, capped at a maximum width of `1280px` to maintain optimal data scanning speeds. Left-rail pinned navigation (`260px` fixed), dynamic dashboard workspace, and a contextual side drawer for transaction details.

### Spacing Principles
- Gaps between logical cards never drop below `space-md` (16px).
- Internal card padding scales between `space-md` (compact mobile records) and `space-lg` (hero dashboard overview panels).
- Fixed floating action bars adhere to a strict bottom safe-margin plus `space-md` to remain clear of native navigation handles.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses layered ambient shadows combined with subtle frosted glass to maintain depth without clutter.

### Elevation Levels

- **Level 0 (Flat):** Base canvas `#F6F7FB`. Direct sub-panels, empty states, and inactive card borders.
- **Level 1 (Card Default):** Standard property cards and table rows.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 2px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.04), 0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.02)`
  - Border: `1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8)`
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating / Active Hover):** Swiped cards, active dropdown menus, and raised list items.
  - Background: `#FFFFFF`
  - Shadow: `0px 12px 24px -6px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.08), 0px 4px 8px -2px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.03)`
- **Level 3 (Modal / Persistent Floating Bars):** Floating Action Buttons (FABs), lease verification overlays, bottom sheets.
  - Shadow: `0px 20px 32px -8px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.16), 0px 8px 16px -4px rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`

### Glassmorphism Treatment
- **Executive Card Banners:** Linear gradient from `#0B1026` to `#3B2FA0` with an overlay border of `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)`.
- **Top Bar Filter Strip:** Background `rgba(246, 247, 251, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` and a bottom hairline divider in `rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.06)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action:** 
  - Background: Gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #06B6D4 100%)`.
  - Color: `#FFFFFF`, weight 600 (`label-lg`).
  - Height: `48px` on mobile for tap target ergonomics.
  - Shadow: `0px 4px 14px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35)`.
  - Radius: `12px`.
- **Secondary (Navy Dark):**
  - Background: `#0B1026`. Color: `#FFFFFF`. Radius: `12px`.
- **Ghost / Outlined:**
  - Border: `1.5px solid #E2E8F0`. Color: `#0B1026`. Background: `#FFFFFF`.

### Chips & Filter Tags
- **Default:** Pill-shaped (`9999px`), `32px` height, `#FFFFFF` background, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, typography `label-md` (`#0B1026`).
- **Active Filter:** Background `#0B1026`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #0B1026`.
- **Status Indicator Badges:** Soft translucent tints (e.g., Paid: `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`, text `#10B981`; Overdue: `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)`, text `#EF4444`). 
- **Pro Tier Badge:** Background `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.15), rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.3))`, text `#B45309`, border `1px solid rgba(245, 185, 66, 0.4)`.

### Cards (Property & Ledger Units)
- **Structure:** Clean white `#FFFFFF` shell, `20px` corner radius, `Level 1` elevation.
- **Header Slot:** Left-aligned unit/building identifier (`headline-md`), right-aligned status badge.
- **Body Slot:** Tabular split-view displaying Tenant Name and Rupee Amount (`financial-md`) with sub-labels (`body-sm`).
- **Interactive Stacks:** Tap transitions to `Level 2` elevation with smooth sub-150ms ease curve.

### Input Fields
- **Container:** Height `52px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, corner radius `12px`.
- **States:** Active/Focus state uses `1.5px solid #3B2FA0` with an outer ring of `rgba(59, 47, 160, 0.1)`.
- **Prefix / Suffix Elements:** Persistent rupee symbol `₹` or tenancy dates locked in muted tone (`#64748B`).

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size: `20px × 20px`, corner radius `6px` for checkboxes, `50%` for radios.
- Unchecked: Border `2px solid #CBD5E1`, background `#FFFFFF`.
- Checked: Background `#10B981`, border `#10B981`, white crisp checkmark/inner dot.

### Specialized System Components
- **Floating Tenant Quick-Action Dock:** A docked mobile pill fixed at screen bottom with a glassmorphic dark container (`rgba(11, 16, 38, 0.9)`, backdrop blur `20px`, rounded-full) containing dynamic shortcuts for "Collect Rent", "Log Expense", and "Draft Lease".
- **Rupee Ledger Row:** Borderless list row featuring an avatar anchor, auto-formatted currency block with sign indicator (+/-), and split status color indicator.
